note: Family-owned park across the highway from the Laura Ingalls Wilder Home and Museum in Mansfield, with grassy, level sites and a small fishing pond. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $35-50 (now dated 2025 from the operator page), 23 sites, 70-ft pull-throughs; added 50A, showers/laundry, year-round, phone-only reservations. Monthly rates marketed but reviews read as overnight travellers: passes the long-stay tests. Not waterfront confirmed (pond ~0.1 ha). Entry has no phone: add 417-554-1302.
flags: PHONE: the entry has none; add 417-554-1302 (the operator page's reservation line; Google lists the same).

LONG-STAY CHECK (monthly marketed, $450-600 with utilities): tests (1) $35 base <= $50 PASS; (2) posted nightly rates on its own page plus a phone PASS; (3) no minimum PASS; (4) the page sells all 23 sites by the night, no count of monthly sites PASS; (5) an RV park PASS. Occupancy: the newest Google reviews read are all transient guests - 'took my late call and let me arrive late', 'Ideal location for visiting the Laura Ingalls Wilder museum across the street... so inexpensive for us to camp for the night', 'We had a pull through gravel spot that was level', 'We stopped for two nights to give my wife a full day at the Laura Ingalls Wilder Home and Museum' (Tripadvisor). No sign of a residents' park. Keep.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. The fishing pond is ~40x30 m (~0.1 ha, a pond under the ~5-acre line) and the nearest pads are 50 m+ from it.
PIN: stored 37.0996,-92.5680 sits in the site loop. Fine.
